posts.author: Fathin Dosunmu
posts.headline: 4 Love of the GAME | Agentic Madness
posts.text:
Browser agents do not usually fail at clicking buttons.

They fail where the workflow becomes real: authentication, state, timeouts, and ownership.

If you are taking an agent into a real workflow, where does it become unreliable?

posts.tag: Real public post by Fathin · FP-10
posts.author: Fathin Dosunmu
posts.headline: 4 Love of the GAME | Agentic Madness
posts.text:
THE AGENT SAYS IT'S DONE.

WOULD THE SYSTEM IT TOUCHED AGREE?

A fluent answer can hide the wrong record, a skipped required check, or an uncertain tool result treated as success.

What evidence would prove your agent actually finished?
